timeline.summary: Mahabir Prasad Agrawal (on behalf of self and PACs) declared no encumbrance on 57.46% of Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Limited shares for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹227.46 Cr (+9.4% YoY), net profit ₹5.37 Cr (+6.8% YoY).
Manaksia Coated Metals filed the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 showing ₹120.90 Cr utilized from preferential issue proceeds.
Manaksia Coated Metals released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation highlighting a 14% increase in total income to ₹896.27 Cr.
Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Limited shared the Investor Conference Call recording for Q4 FY2026-27 results on 07.05.2026 via its website.
Manaksia Coated Metals reported record FY26 revenue of ₹896.27 Cr and PAT of ₹40.69 Cr, backed by strong export growth and premiumization.
Manaksia Coated Metals reported Q1FY27 results with 5% YoY revenue growth to ₹262.14 Cr and improved EBITDA margin to 11.06%
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹318.69 Cr (+44.6% YoY), net profit ₹18.73 Cr (+34.2% YoY).
Manaksia Coated Metals opened its qualified institutions placement with a floor price of ₹127.01 per share.
Manaksia Coated Metals reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹318.69 Cr and net profit of ₹18.73 Cr.
